title: The lender's benchmark ratios
status: The levels a project's ratios are read against, each in its worst year (D-UX-51), and the values of the collateral (D-UX-52). The owner's figures (11-10-2026): only the benchmark level, no relaxation or deviation; each lender sets its own.
source: The owner's benchmarks, said to follow RBI; not yet checked against an RBI publication

cases.renewal: An existing loan on review or renewal

ratios.label: Current ratio
ratios.how: (stock + debtors + cash) ÷ (the working-capital limit + creditors), at each year's end

ratios.label: Total outside liabilities ÷ net worth
ratios.how: (unsecured loans + the term loan + the working-capital limit + creditors) ÷ net worth

ratios.label: Term loan ÷ net worth (debt-equity)
ratios.how: the term loan outstanding ÷ net worth

ratios.label: Average DSCR
ratios.how: total cash available ÷ total debt service, over the loan

ratios.label: DSCR in the lowest year
ratios.how: the year's cash available ÷ its debt service

ratios.label: Interest cover
ratios.how: (profit before tax + all interest) ÷ all interest

ratios.label: Fixed-asset cover
ratios.how: net fixed assets ÷ the term loan outstanding

ratios.label: Security cover
ratios.how: (net fixed assets + stock + debtors + the collateral's realisable sale value) ÷ (the term loan + the working-capital limit outstanding)

collateral.source: The owner's figures (11-10-2026): realisable sale value 90% of the market value, which MSME lenders use for security cover; distress sale value 80%, shown

term.source: The owner's figure (11-10-2026): an MSME term loan's longest, the moratorium included

capacity.source: A placeholder (D-UX-52): the highest use of the capacity a plan assumes; type the business's own reason if higher
